CI only, served only by the app built with the probe feature (desktop/src/probe.rs): loaded into the room window with SIDEVOICE_DEBUG=1 SIDEVOICE_DEBUG_PAGE=memory.html and SIDEVOICE_DEBUG_IDLE_MINUTE_MS. It walks the app through what a long session does (calls with models loaded, the models' idle keep running out, many calls, the call controls card's settings, the audio devices, the voice settings) and has the app print its own memory at each step (probe-memory PHASE lines, src/probe.rs); cargo xtask probe memory checks the numbers (#145).
